summary: The StudentRequirements system manages student-related data using ASP.NET controls and handles operations like adding, editing, and deleting student records.
purpose: To manage and display student requirements data using a web-based interface.

workflows.name: Manage Student Requirements
steps: User interacts with the gridData to add, edit, or delete student records.
Add button setup in gridData if screen is editable.
Edit and delete buttons setup based on screen editability.
Data bound and 'no data found' message adjusted for read-only view.
Row commands handled for add, edit, and delete operations.
Details are shown in modal popup extender.
Changes committed to data layer upon operation completion.

validations: Cancel operation if Page.IsValid is false during insert or update.
system_behavior: ObjectDataSource operations are cancelled if UserSession is null.
Redirect occurs after operations are completed.
